text:
Matt: Heads-up — customer complaint about being charged for a toolcall twice when their streaming response got truncated and then resumed. Logs show two provisional ledger entries. Anyone seen this pattern before?

Julia: Ugh. yes, saw similar once with prefetch resume. Usually happens when router falls back to another path and both sides provisional-credit.

Shiv: Do we have a session id being preserved across the resume? if not, dedupe is hard. what headers did the client send?

Matt: Customer trace shows `x-session-id: 0x9f1a` present on client side but router rewrote path and downstream lost it during handoff. snippet of router log: ```INFO router: handoff session=0x9f1a -> backend-a; provisional_charge=120 tokens
INFO backend-a: streamed 80 tokens; client disconnect; session_mark=provisional
INFO router: fallback to backend-b; new_session=0x9f1a -> backend-b; provisional_charge=40 tokens
INFO backend-b: resumed 40 tokens; confirmed_charge=...```

Olivia: The ledger treats provisional charges per backend-host-session. If the session id is same but host differs we treat them independently because we can't guarantee idempotency. That was by-design to avoid undercharging if resume went to different model variant.

Julia: Right, but UX here is terrible for customers. If we can detect same `x-session-id` across backends within a short window, we could attempt dedupe or mark as single logical session in the billing layer. Need telemetry to be confident.

BillingBot: FYI automated alert: 3 customers affected in last 24h with >100 token delta. Investigating.

Shiv: Two options: 1) propagate a global resume token that is canonical and enforced by router (stronger sticky routing) or 2) add dedupe hints to ledger: 'possible-duplicate-of: <session-id>' and a reconciliation job that consolidates provisional entries within grace window. Option 1 touches routing policy and may regress availability. Option 2 defers to offline cleanup.

Matt: Preference toward 2 for short term. Can we at least surface these provisional duplicates in Console so customer success can see "provisional split charges" and not auto bill?

Olivia: We already have a provisional tag but it's per-ledger-entry. We could add a UI filter "provisional grouped by session-id" and show potential duplicates. The backend needs to emit `provisional_group_id` when session-id is observed.

Julia: Also need better telemetry metrics: count of provisional entries with identical session-id across different backends, time delta distribution, and fraction that reconcile to confirmed double-charges.

Shiv: Implementation plan: 1) Router: stop rewriting session-id header on handoff; add `x-resume-canonical` header passthrough when present. 2) Ledger: accept optional `provisional_group_id` string and index by it. 3) Reconcile job: merge provisional entries into one confirmed charge if they share group_id and total tokens match resumed pattern within 60s. 4) Console: new provisional-group view + alert.

Olivia: Risk: if we merge incorrectly we undercharge when a true duplicate happens (two independent sessions using same random id). How unique is `x-session-id`? We should treat it as high entropy but add namespace e.g., `client-id|random` or `sdk-v2` signing.

Matt: Customer SDKs currently generate 128-bit random, low collision risk. We should still have a reconciliation backstop: only auto-merge when metadata (model variant, prompt hash) also matches or when one entry was explicitly marked as resumed by backend.

Shiv: Agreed. I'll prototype ledger schema change to accept `provisional_group_id` and a `resume_marker` bool. If resume_marker true on a subsequent provisional entry that references same group id, reconciliation is allowed.

Julia: For rollout: feature-flag ledger changes, enable Console visibility first (no auto-merge), then enable offline reconcile job with a dry-run mode that reports potential merges. After 1 week of low false positives we can enable auto-merge for low-risk matches.

Matt: Sounds good. Action items: Shiv PR for ledger schema and reconcile dry-run (ETA 3d). Olivia Console mockups for provisional-group view (ETA 2d). Julia create telemetry dashboards for provisional-group counts and false-positive rate (ETA 2d). I'll notify CS and legal about plan.

deploy-bot: matt initiated deploy request: feature/ledger-provisional -> staging. CI: ✅ lint, ✅ unit tests, ❌ integration (flaky).

Olivia: Please hold on deploy until we have the UI so CS doesn't get alarmed. We can merge but gate deploy.

Matt: Good call. keep me posted. thanks all. :thumbsup:
